author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದಾಳವನು ಉರುಳಿಸಲು ಶಕುನಿಯೇ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ
ಹಾಳುಮಾಡುವ ಬುದ್ಧಿ ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಇಹುದು
ಬಾಳ ಕಟ್ಟುತ ನಡೆಯೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಬುದ್ಧಿಯೆ ಸಾಕು
ಸೀಳಿನಡೆ ದುಷ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: You don’t need Śakuni to roll the dice;
the mind that ruins things is inside you;
to walk on building a life, a good mind is enough;
cut through wrongdoing as you walk, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We need no Śakuni, the scheming dice-player of the Mahābhārata, to ruin us; the destructive impulse is within. A good mind is all we need to build a good life.
